definitions.gloss: remarks column; notes section; comments field
definitions.explanation: A designated space on a form, document, or application for writing additional notes, comments, or supplementary information.

examples.japanese: {備考欄|びこうらん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please fill in the remarks column.

examples.japanese: ⟦アレルギー→アレルギー：04645_arerugii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{備考欄|びこうらん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{書|か}き→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If you have any allergies, please write them in the notes section.

examples.japanese: {備考欄|びこうらん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{特記|とっき}すべきこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なければ→ない：01118_nai⟧、⟦{空欄|くうらん}→空欄：15892_kuuran⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{結構|けっこう}→結構：10387_kekkou⟧です。
examples.english: If there is nothing special to note in the remarks column, you may leave it blank.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{備考|びこう}→備考：15693_bikou⟧ (remarks, notes) + ⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧ (column, field). The ⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧ suffix is used for various sections of forms and documents.

USAGE:
Very common on Japanese forms of all kinds — application forms, medical forms, order forms, surveys, and official documents. Knowing this word is essential for navigating Japanese bureaucracy and paperwork.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {備考欄|びこうらん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to fill in the remarks section)
- {備考欄|びこうらん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write in the notes column)
- {備考欄|びこうらん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{空欄|くうらん}→空欄：15892_kuuran⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧よい (the remarks column can be left blank)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{備考|びこう}→備考：15693_bikou⟧: remarks, notes — the content itself, without the 'column' part
- ⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧: column, field — used in many compounds like ⟦{解答欄|かいとうらん}→解答欄：17901_kaitouran⟧ (answer section) and ⟦{記入欄|きにゅうらん}→記入欄：21276_kinyuuran⟧ (entry field)
